prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Stormhead: a rain-lashed headland, dark surf, wind-bent moor and a lone beacon above slate cliffs. A bold, windswept melody with low strings and a steady hand-drum pulse. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 1 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
